description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Ice/Lightning Ability +15% Boost 6]/[Ice/Lightning Ability +30% Boost 6] to all allies if 0-3/4+ allies have any Attach Ice or Attach Lightning, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Lightning)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Life Mode I: Vivi] and [(Ice/Lightning) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Ice/Lightning Ability +15% Boost 6

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] after using a Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: (Ice/Lightning) Resonance +5% Boost
